canonical_name: bitbank 暗号資産を貸して増やす
aliases: 暗号資産を貸して増やす
summary: Active centralized crypto-asset lending service operated by Bitbank, Inc. Current first-party material documents one-year maturity, contractual lending-fee return mechanics, early termination, and a custody boundary distinct from ordinary segregated exchange custody.
what_happened: bitbank currently operates its crypto-asset lending service. First-party support states that the standard maturity is one year after contract formation and that the lent crypto plus the prescribed usage/lending fee is returned within the published return window after maturity. First-party support also documents early termination through support subject to an early-termination fee. In its Ethereum PoW fork guidance, bitbank explicitly distinguished ETH lent through the service from the segregated-management balance used for ordinary exchange custody in that context. CYA therefore records lending counterparty exposure and does not generalize ordinary exchange-custody protections to lent balances. Annual transaction-report guidance establishes operation by historical reporting periods but does not establish an exact original launch date, so no launch date is inferred.
uncertainty_notes: Exact original launch date is not established by the reviewed first-party evidence. Published lending-fee rates are issuer product terms, not independently verified realized returns. Current return mechanics do not establish universal historical repayment performance.
notes: Promoted in Phase 10 from duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000132 after candidate-only PR #270 passed the hardened exact-head scanner against the 113-platform canonical corpus.
